title: Hypericin attenuates myocardial ischemia-reperfusion injury by enhancing mitochondrial energy metabolism via AMPK/PGC-1alpha signaling pathway.
authors: Huihui, L I; Yali, Bao; Wanyue, L I; Huitian, Xin; Xiaofeng, Gao; Ainiwar, Dina; Can, Ling; Anwaier, Gulinigaer; Zhan, Sun
one_liner_zh: 该文研究金丝桃素通过AMPK/PGC-1alpha通路改善心肌缺血再灌注损伤，属于心血管疾病机制研究，与蛋白质-DNA互作及AI/物理模拟方法完全无关。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Although blood flow is restored following the treatment of acute myocardial infarction (AMI), myocardial Ischaemia /reperfusion can still cause cardiac damage, potentially leading to cardiac decompensation and, ultimately, heart failure. This study aimed to investigate the effects of Hypericin (Hyp) on the hearts of rats with myocardial ischaemia-reperfusion injury (MIRI) and its underlying mechanisms. METHODS: Male Sprague-Dawley rats and H9C2 cells underwent MIRI and hypoxia/reoxygenation (H/R) modelling after Hyp administration to assess the compound's effects on cardiac and cardiomyocyte characteristics, as well as mitochondrial energy metabolism. A range of techniques, including 2,3,5-triphenyltetrazolium chloride staining, haematoxylin-eosin staining, echocardiography, enzyme-linked immunosorbent assay, quantitative proteomics analysis, molecular docking, and Western blotting were employed to further characterize Hyp's cardioprotective effects and its influence on related molecular expressions. TUNEL staining and Western blotting were also used to examine the morphological, molecular, and functional phenotypes of H/R-treated cardiomyocytes. RESULTS: Hyp significantly reduced myocardial infarct size and improved cardiac function in MIRI rats. Hyp increased cardiomyocyte viability while decreasing cardiomyocyte damage. The cardioprotective effects of Hyp were primarily mediated by alleviating mitochondrial dysfunction and oxidative stress, mainly through the adenosine monophosphate-activated protein kinase (AMPK)/peroxisome proliferator-activated receptor gamma coactivator 1-alpha (PGC-1alpha) signalling pathway. CONCLUSION: Hyp regulates the AMPK/PGC-1alpha signalling pathway to improve mitochondrial energy metabolism and reduce oxidative stress, thereby mitigating MIRI in rats.
abstract_zh: 背景：尽管急性心肌梗死（AMI）治疗后血流得以恢复，但心肌缺血/再灌注仍可造成心脏损伤，可能导致心脏失代偿，并最终发展为心力衰竭。本研究旨在探讨金丝桃素（Hypericin, Hyp）对大鼠心肌缺血-再灌注损伤（MIRI）心脏的影响及其潜在机制。方法：雄性Sprague-Dawley大鼠和H9C2细胞在给予Hyp后进行MIRI和缺氧/复氧（H/R）建模，以评估该化合物对心脏和心肌细胞特性以及线粒体能量代谢的影响。采用一系列技术，包括2,3,5-三苯基氯化四氮唑染色、苏木精-伊红染色、超声心动图、酶联免疫吸附测定、定量蛋白质组学分析、分子对接和Western blotting，进一步表征Hyp的心脏保护作用及其对相关分子表达的影响。同时使用TUNEL染色和Western blotting检测H/R处理心肌细胞的形态学、分子和功能表型。结果：Hyp显著减小MIRI大鼠的心肌梗死面积并改善心脏功能。Hyp增加心肌细胞活力，同时减少心肌细胞损伤。Hyp的心脏保护作用主要通过缓解线粒体功能障碍和氧化应激介导，主要涉及腺苷一磷酸激活蛋白激酶（AMPK）/过氧化物酶体增殖物激活受体γ共激活因子1-α（PGC-1alpha）信号通路。结论：Hyp调节AMPK/PGC-1alpha信号通路，改善线粒体能量代谢并减少氧化应激，从而减轻大鼠MIRI。
